notes: English item names and descriptions were checked against the rendered PDF pages. Descriptions are lightly normalized for spelling, punctuation and casing without adding ingredients.
Blank descriptions indicate that no English ingredient description was supplied. Ingredients have not been inferred from photographs or item names.
All image fields are null, ready for real dish photographs to be added later.
The PDF heading Vegan Salad includes chicken, shrimp, salmon, steak and dairy dishes. The extracted category is named Salads and no dietary labels are inferred.
The Impossible Burger description in the source explicitly includes beef. The name has not been interpreted as a plant-based claim.
Unusual source wording such as Freeze lettuce, Taislaw, Fajitha and Kuwaithy is retained for owner review. sourceName preserves changed item spellings.
The source groups Corn Flakes and Oats under Hot Drink. That grouping is retained pending owner review.
Source page numbers are one-based PDF page numbers, including covers and photo-only pages.
